objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Do not treat mapped teardown as a reporting or durability boundary: the VFile interface returns void from unmap, and the POSIX implementation ignores both msync(MS_SYNC) and munmap results.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Confirmed from complete pinned source. PR #13's fd fixture wraps the syscalls, observes both failures and their order, and confirms savedata pointers are cleared. The injected close wrapper and visible file bytes are host-specific observations only.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No actual power-loss, reboot, kernel failure, other OS, or real filesystem teardown-failure evidence. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: A bool close result exists, but GBAUnloadROM ignores realVf->close and clears the pointer. The test's simulated close failure is not proof that a real failed close leaves the descriptor open or retryable.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Confirmed source and fixture: injected close returns before the real syscall, the VFile wrapper remains allocated, and the fixture safely retries it. This models the caller's ignored false result but not POSIX close-on-error semantics on every host.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: Actual OS close failure state is unresolved; retained wrapper lifetime/leak behavior after GBAUnloadROM is not repaired or approved.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Do not generalize POSIX or stdio teardown results to memory VFiles: unmap is a no-op, sync reports true, and close ownership differs between borrowed memory and VFileMemChunk.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Confirmed in pinned implementation and the sixth fd matrix case. The controls establish ownership distinctions for those memory VFiles only.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: Allocation failures and other memory-backed callers are not covered. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: The stdio backend has multiple distinct result paths: unmap returns void and ignores fseek/fwrite; truncate ignores zero-fill fwrite; sync returns false on short element write or fflush failure; close returns false after fclose failure while retaining its VFile wrapper.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Confirmed by complete pinned source and the seven-case stdio fixture's source-derived method hashes. Controlled cases demonstrate mapped short-unmap, injected fflush failure, /dev/full write failure, and close error without treating them as filesystem-wide behavior.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: The fixture does not test short writes in _vffTruncate or all map/seek failure paths; no exact-head PR CI ran this stdio code. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: A retained wrapper after fclose reports failure is not evidence that the underlying FILE stream is safe to retry. GBAUnloadROM drops the realVf pointer regardless.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: The seven-case test confirms the cookie close callback returned EIO and the wrapper was retained, then manually frees the wrapper; it intentionally does not retry fclose. This is correctly narrower than the fd fake-close assumption.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No retry safety, frontend error, or resource-recovery conclusion; the wrapper ownership/lifetime after caller drop remains unresolved.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Close, unmap, and write errors are not uniformly returned to savedata callers. In the raw load path the write count overwrites the read count and success checks only non-negativity; mapped load uses a different exact-length result.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Confirmed source. The stdio test's controlled 3-of-8 raw output write returns success; the mapped masked-read fixture shows unmask ignores GBASavedataLoad's false result and clears maskWriteback.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No complete native matrix of negative read, zero/short/failed writes, read errors, allocation failure, or all call sites. Local workpaper reports are not the current exact-head CI.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Masked and unmasked teardown have different VFile ownership and result propagation; do not infer successful writeback from unmask completion.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: The fd fixture combines short masked read with injected sync/unmap/close errors; the stdio fixture independently checks short read and subsequent writeback visibility. The code clears maskWriteback and ignores relevant results.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No exact-head workflow execution for current PR13 head, nor frontend/real-game behavior. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: A dirty-to-clean transition or callback cannot be treated as evidence that sync succeeded or that a user was notified.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Source shows dirty state is updated before VFile sync; failed sync skips RTC write; GBAFrameEnded tests wasDirty && !dirty independently of sync. The stdio /dev/full case observes cleared dirty state and no RTC write, but does not execute the frame callback or a frontend.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No exact frontend callback/UI behavior and no exact-head CI for stdio package. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: A stdio fixture compiled with ENABLE_VFS_FILE does not establish the backend selected by every mGBA frontend or platform.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: The workpaper verifies the specific compile-time dispatch order and test configuration. The fd, memory, and stdio backends are separate contracts.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No full frontend/platform build matrix. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: The teardown call chain must distinguish void core/deinit and VFile unmap contracts from bool close; tests do not compile the full GBA core lifecycle.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Pinned source traces _GBACoreDeinit -> GBADestroy -> GBAUnloadROM -> savedata unmask/deinit -> VFile unmap/close. PR #13 workpaper explicitly labels the full core chain source-audited, not compiled or executed.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No full-core compiled teardown run or frontend ownership audit. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Do not claim a script callback or UI error notification from teardown observations.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: The relevant callback condition is in GBAFrameEnded, not GBAUnloadROM. The PR #13 teardown workpapers expressly do not claim a native script/UI error callback; the two scripting files remain closure references rather than validated callback behavior.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: Frontend callback consumers have not been independently traced/executed. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Transitive headers included in the workpapers' build/dependency closure must not be silently presented as independently reviewed teardown semantics.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Their exact blobs, bytes, dossier rows, and MPL notices are verified; files explicitly marked dependency-only make no behavioral claim.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No semantic disposition is proposed for dependency-only files. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: The memory-map declarations and memory-backed VFile constructors do not establish allocation-failure behavior across teardown callers.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: The pinned header declares anonymousMemoryMap and mappedMemoryFree only; PR13's six fd cases include ordinary memory-backend ownership but do not inject allocation failure.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: No allocation-failure injection or caller-wide recovery evidence. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE.

objection_resolution_matrix.objection: Fresh-process reads through the same host kernel/page cache do not establish durable persistence, emulator behavior, physical Flash, or cross-platform error semantics.
objection_resolution_matrix.resolution: Both PR #13 workpapers explicitly distinguish Linux fault injection and page-cache visibility from process-crash/reboot, power loss, fsync durability, non-Linux backends, stock gameplay, and physical media.
objection_resolution_matrix.remaining: Windows, stdio truncation failures, 3DS/PSP2, crash/power-loss, and end-user save behavior remain untested.
